name: evolclaw
description: AI Agent gateway connecting multiple backends (Claude, Codex, Gemini) to messaging channels (Feishu, WeChat, AUN, QQ) with multi-project session management

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && node -e "const f='dist/cli/index.js',c=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))require('fs').writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c)" && node -e "try{require('child_process').execFileSync('chmod',['+x','dist/cli/index.js'])}catch{}" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/utils/error-dict.json','dist/utils/error-dict.json');require('fs').copyFileSync('src/utils/model-prices.jsonl','dist/utils/model-prices.jsonl')"
